UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Student profile associated with a Google account.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student.

displayName.description: Student display name from Google account.

email.description: Lowercase Google email address of the student (visible only to owner and admin).

photoURL.description: Optional avatar URL from Google account.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the student profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the student profile was last updated.

NotebookWord.title: NotebookWord
NotebookWord.description: A vocabulary word saved to a student's personal Vocabulary Notebook.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner student.

definition.description: Uzbek meaning (for B1) or English definition (for B2/C1).

collocations.description: Up to 10 common collocations for the word.

savedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds when the word was saved.

nextReviewDate.description: Epoch milliseconds for next scheduled review.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the notebook entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the notebook entry was last updated.

LearnedWord.title: LearnedWord
LearnedWord.description: A target vocabulary word marked as learned by a student for the Vocabulary Gym.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner student.

cefrLevel.description: CEFR level of the learned word.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the word was marked as learned.

StudentSubscription.title: StudentSubscription
StudentSubscription.description: Pro subscription status managed by the Admin (ollohberdiinfo@gmail.com) and keyed by normalized student email.

emailKey.description: Normalized email key matching document ID.

studentEmail.description: Lowercase Google email address of the student.

studentName.description: Display name or label for the student.

proUntil.description: Epoch milliseconds when Pro subscription expires (0 if revoked).

planLabel.description: Human-readable subscription tier label (e.g., 30 Days Pro).

updatedByEmail.description: Admin email that last updated the subscription.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the subscription record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the subscription record was last updated.

SubscriptionSettings.title: SubscriptionSettings
SubscriptionSettings.description: Public subscription pricing and Telegram contact instructions managed by the Admin.

monthlyPriceText.description: Displayed monthly subscription price (e.g., 39,000 UZS / month).

paymentInstructions.description: Instructions shown in the Pro Upgrade modal.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when settings were last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores each student's Google profile metadata (readable only by owner or admin).

/users/{userId}/notebook/{wordId}.description: Subcollection storing each student's personal saved Vocabulary Notebook words.

/users/{userId}/learned/{wordId}.description: Subcollection storing each student's learned vocabulary word IDs for the Vocabulary Gym.

/subscriptions/{emailKey}.description: Stores Pro subscription expiration timestamps per student email, writable exclusively by admin ollohberdiinfo@gmail.com.

/settings/{settingId}.description: Stores public Pro subscription pricing and Telegram contact details, writable exclusively by admin ollohberdiinfo@gmail.com.
